name: Notte
tagline: Framework and browser platform for building reliable AI web agents.
description: Notte is a full-stack platform for building and running AI web agents: it turns any website into a structured action API so agents can click, fill forms, and navigate flows instead of scraping raw text. It offers managed cloud browser sessions, serverless browser functions, credential vaults, proxies, CAPTCHA handling, session replays, and observability, with compatibility for Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, and CDP tooling. A source-available framework on GitHub underpins the hosted platform.
insight: YC-backed; its framework ships under the Server Side Public License (SSPL) — source-available, not OSI-approved open source.

modelSupport.notes: Browser infrastructure for agents; you bring the LLM that drives them.

edge: Turns any site into a structured action API and runs agents on managed serverless browser infra, compatible with Playwright, Puppeteer, and Selenium.
cons: SSPL license, not true OSI open source
